questionEn: How do “periods” differ in meaning - choose the correct description?
questionUz: "Davrlar" qanday ma'noda farqlanadi - to'g'ri tavsifni tanlang?
choicesEn: Periods are horizontal lines starting with an alkali metal and ending with an inert gas.
Increasing atomic number and periodic repetition of properties
Vertical column of elements with similar properties
choicesUz: Davrlar ishqoriy metalldan boshlanib, inert gaz bilan tugaydigan gorizontal chiziqlardir.
Atom sonini oshirish va xususiyatlarning davriy takrorlanishi
Xuddi shunday xususiyatlarga ega bo'lgan elementlarning vertikal ustuni
explanationEn: Periods are horizontal lines starting with an alkali metal and ending with an inert gas.
explanationUz: Davrlar ishqoriy metalldan boshlanib, inert gaz bilan tugaydigan gorizontal chiziqlardir.
